landing.heroBadge: Free to join · Surveys matched to you
landing.heroSubtitle: Answer short surveys and polls picked for you, and help brands build products people actually want.
landing.step1Desc: Tell us a little about yourself so we can match you with the right surveys.
landing.step2Desc: Pick what interests you — most take just a few minutes.
landing.step3Desc: Check how the community voted and watch your answers shape real decisions.
landing.feature1Desc: Your profile decides which surveys you see, so you skip the ones that don't fit.
landing.feature2Desc: Short surveys, one-tap polls and games that fit into a coffee break.
landing.feature3Desc: Vote in polls and see straight away how everyone else answered.
landing.feature4Desc: Privacy-first and DPDP 2023 compliant. You decide what you share.
landing.communitySubtitle: Brands use what our members say to shape the products and services they build next.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to share what you think?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join free in a couple of minutes and start sharing what you think.
